Name: Organized Big Shed
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

In the Big Shed Vanilla I never had enough space, too small, and then it was hard to divide the space for what I wanted to put in it and I would end up with a Shed in total chaos, so I created this one, in here you can put barrels in to age if you want, now it's more organized!
<3 You can change the floors and wallpaper
<3 Is enabled for barrels to age like in the cellar
<3 All walls are decoratable

Enjoy! <3

Installation:
Extract and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.
